tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground of every screen (deep blue-black in dark, cool paper in light, never pure black). Text on it: text, text-soft, text-faint, the pens.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: First raised step: panels, the top bar, inputs. Same text tokens as surface.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Second raised step: teacher cards, menus, the command palette.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Third step: pressed or selected rows, hint highlights, inset wells. Do not set pen-coloured text on a pen-soft fill here (4.2:1); use text.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline rules that divide columns and rows. Decorative structure, not a control border.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls, inputs and focusable cards (3:1 or more on every surface). Also the neutral leader line of a hint.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Reading text and the answer. The brightest thing on a screen. On surface to surface-3 in both themes.

tokens.name: text-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, nav, captions. On surface to surface-3.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Metadata only (dates, counts, hints of state). Still 4.5:1 on every surface, but never for anything you must read.

tokens.name: pen-red
tokens.usage: Red pen = critical: wrong, stale, missed. Lines, underlines and text on surface to surface-2. Always paired with a SOLID underline or line. Never decorative.

tokens.name: pen-red-soft
tokens.usage: Highlight behind passages the red pen marks. Put text, not pen-red, on it.

tokens.name: pen-green
tokens.usage: Green pen = right: verified, passed, understood. Lines and text on surface to surface-2. Always paired with a DOUBLE underline or line.

tokens.name: pen-green-soft
tokens.usage: Highlight behind passages the green pen marks. Put text, not pen-green, on it.

tokens.name: pen-blue
tokens.usage: Blue pen = discussion and links. Link text, dotted underlines, the discussion pin and the focus ring (2px, offset 2px). Always paired with a DOTTED underline or line.

tokens.name: pen-blue-soft
tokens.usage: Highlight behind discussed passages. Put text, not pen-blue, on it.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px blue ring, offset 2px, 6:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Code only: keywords, tags and preprocessor lines, always bold as well. Violet, a hue no pen uses. On surface to surface-3. Never outside a code block.

tokens.name: syntax-literal
tokens.usage: Code only: strings, numbers and other literal values. Amber, a hue no pen uses. On surface to surface-3. Never outside a code block.

tokens.name: survey-surface
tokens.usage: Direction B ground: teal-slate, never pure black. Replaces surface when a screen is set in Survey.

tokens.name: survey-surface-1
tokens.usage: Direction B first raised step (land, panels).

tokens.name: survey-surface-2
tokens.usage: Direction B second raised step (cards, menus).

tokens.name: survey-surface-3
tokens.usage: Direction B third step (selected rows, wells).

tokens.name: survey-rule
tokens.usage: Direction B hairlines and the ticks of a measured rule.

tokens.name: survey-rule-strong
tokens.usage: Direction B control borders, region outlines, route lines (3:1 or more on every Survey surface).

tokens.name: survey-grid
tokens.usage: The graticule behind the Atlas. Decorative, never carries a label.

tokens.name: survey-text
tokens.usage: Direction B reading text and map labels on survey-surface to survey-surface-3.

tokens.name: survey-text-soft
tokens.usage: Direction B secondary text and contour lines on survey-surface to survey-surface-3.

tokens.name: survey-text-faint
tokens.usage: Direction B metadata: grid references, counts. 4.5:1 on every Survey surface.

tokens.name: instrument-surface
tokens.usage: Direction C chrome ground: the housing around the instruments.

tokens.name: instrument-panel
tokens.usage: Direction C panel face: readouts, lists, the teacher column.

tokens.name: instrument-panel-2
tokens.usage: Direction C raised panel: teacher readouts, menus.

tokens.name: instrument-bezel
tokens.usage: Direction C 1px rules between panels. Decorative structure.

tokens.name: instrument-bezel-strong
tokens.usage: Direction C control borders and tick marks (3:1 on every Instrument surface).

tokens.name: instrument-text
tokens.usage: Direction C text on the chrome and panels.

tokens.name: instrument-text-soft
tokens.usage: Direction C labels on the chrome and panels.

tokens.name: instrument-text-faint
tokens.usage: Direction C metadata on the chrome and panels. 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: instrument-paper
tokens.usage: Direction C reading surface (problem, answer): a warm graphite in dark, near-white in light. The warmth lives here and nowhere else.

tokens.name: instrument-ink
tokens.usage: Direction C reading text on instrument-paper.

tokens.name: instrument-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Direction C secondary text on instrument-paper.

tokens.name: instrument-ink-faint
tokens.usage: Direction C metadata on instrument-paper. 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: retro-surface
tokens.usage: Retro option ground: warm black tube in dark, fanfold paper in light. Replaces surface when a screen is set in the retro option.

tokens.name: retro-surface-1
tokens.usage: Retro option first raised step (panels, land on the Atlas).

tokens.name: retro-surface-2
tokens.usage: Retro option second raised step (teacher cards, closed folders).

tokens.name: retro-surface-3
tokens.usage: Retro option third step (pressed and selected).

tokens.name: retro-rule
tokens.usage: Retro option hairlines and scan rules. Decorative structure.

tokens.name: retro-rule-strong
tokens.usage: Retro option control borders, panel frames and routes (3:1 or more on every retro surface).

tokens.name: retro-text
tokens.usage: Retro option text: pale straw phosphor in dark, dark green-black ink in light. On retro-surface to retro-surface-3.

tokens.name: retro-text-soft
tokens.usage: Retro option secondary text, contours. On retro-surface to retro-surface-3.

tokens.name: retro-text-faint
tokens.usage: Retro option metadata. 4.5:1 or more on every retro surface.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a note or card.

styles.name: subheading
styles.sample: Why the recurrent input is Gaussian

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Notes, problems and the answer. About 70 characters a line in the Library reader.
styles.sample: Each term has mean 0 and variance g²/N q.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Right, and it is why the variances add.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav, field labels, row status. Sentence case, no tracking.
styles.sample: Ask an agent to mark it

styles.name: label-strong
styles.usage: Active nav item, card kind (Hint 2 of 3, Feedback).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and the line of the editor being written (source shown).

styles.name: number-lg
styles.usage: Streak counters. Numbers first, labels second.

styles.name: map-label
styles.usage: Atlas region and note labels (Martian Mono, width axis set with font-variation-settings).

styles.name: pixel-number
styles.usage: Big numbers only (Departure Mono). Used in direction C; direction A does not use it.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows in a list, between pin cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutters, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between a heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a column.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between columns of the workbench (problem to answer).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Leader-line run between the answer and the teacher margin.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Highlights behind marked passages, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, pin cards. Keep corners small: structure comes from rules, not from soft cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Menus and the command palette only.
